verification.expect: Core Platform (CORE), category Platform, Standard support; Max Users 100, Storage 50 GB, API Calls 10,000/month, pricing $29/user/month ($24/user/month annual); 6 features listed starting with Contact Management and ending with Mobile App

verification.ask: What does the Enterprise full suite cost for 500 users on annual billing?

verification.ask: Can we run Analytics Pro next to Analytics Standard?
